usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve historical performance metrics (CPU, memory, disk, network, swap, and pressure stall information) for a specific PDM node over a chosen timeframe. Both `cf` and `timeframe` are required — choose `AVERAGE` for trend analysis and `MAX` to catch spike behavior. Data points may have null/missing fields for metrics the node does not expose; always check for optional field presence before graphing.

examples.summary: Fetch hourly average CPU and memory metrics for the local PDM node

tips: Use 'localhost' as the node name when querying the PDM node you are directly connected to — it is always valid regardless of the configured hostname.
AVERAGE smooths over collection intervals and is best for capacity planning; MAX reveals peak bursts that AVERAGE would hide.
The 'decade' timeframe produces very coarse data points — use it only for long-horizon trend views, not operational alerting.
metric-collection-total-time reflects PDM's own collection overhead; a rising value can indicate the node is under load or a metric source is slow.
All rate fields (disk-read, disk-write, net-in, net-out) are in bytes per second; convert before displaying as MB/s.
